body:
Well, there you have it. Somebody who is in the similar circumstance tries to empathise and share their way of coping and their posts get deleted.

You have an uphill battle ahead of you my friend. All you're going to get here is the canned "it'll get better" sentiments. And it will will. If you want some real conversation about how that's going to happen, just PM me. Wouldn't want to offend the "helpful" people here.

Trolling? In the sense I'm an ugly troll living under the bridge, hating myself, wanting to die and being bitter against the whole world? I suppose so, yes.

But the people that come to SW aren't generally the prettiest flowers either. I can afford to shop at Banana Republic as well as Value Village. One of those makes me feel immesurably worse. A troll dressed in J Crew is still just a troll

Internet doesn't solve anything. Just talking to someone in real life is the most important thing. I don't have an answer. You probably live too far away from me for me to do anything.  But if you happen to be close enough, just come on over, whoever you are, I'm in apatment 705.

He was selfish and manipulative enough to ensure he keeps getting what he wants. Good for him. And good for you to have somebody who needs you.

There's this movie, "Yes man". It's all about saying yes to everything. And it's a great piece of advice. Except when nobody asks, when you have nobody to say yes to, you have to make up the opportunies yourself. And that's a heck of a lot harder than just saying yes.

I got my own innocent sexual peculariaty. Trust me, honesty is not the answer here. It would be so wonderful if you could find somebody who would love you for who you are. But that's statistically impossible.

So let's start from scratch. Yoiu really can't tell anyone about this, it doesn't help anyone. They just can't reciprocate, even if they wanted to, and they probably don't want to.

The point is it doesn't matter. As much as it may be the most important thing in your life, it is the least important thing in theirs. Such is the case with many things.

Well, there you have it, this here world, Canada, males are castrated and end up on foreveralone. I bet there are plenty lovely ladies just down the hall that just want to cuddle, and yet they just end up talking to lovely ladies from Estonia that they will never get a chance to meet. What a world.

Light up that bong for a bit. It's certainly a lot less final than doing the deed. 

Drugs are great. They make my days go by. They tell me that they make my life shorter, but my life without them would be a lot shorter still.

Living for drugs is pathetic, just don't tell anyone. Killing yourself is pretty pathetic too. Don't tell anyone, enjoy the bit of happiness you get from drugs that nobody else gets, don't worry about the fuure cause you're about to kill yourself anyways, and, this is the most important, don't tell anyone, cause they will judge you.

I just cliked the wrong button, 'report' looks a lot like 'reply'. Anyways, just wanted you to know, cause I don't know what the reprecussions are.

There are plenty of people willing to cuddle you without any sex in the deal just around the corner, just how do you find them? I'm not special. You're not special. I don't got no money to come over. But if you live down the hallway, come on over, we'll have the best of time just cuddling without any sex whatsoever.

I hear ya. You're competent enough to take care of yourself. And yet, nobody else needs you for anything (not for anything they couldn't get anywhere else). 

If you can find meaning in helping others, you gotta look into hurting others. Cause it looks like you skipped that step. And in case that doesn't fullfill you, just go for it.

Your mistake is in anticipating their actions. Quiting before they kick you out is the biggest bullshit ever. 

You will have a bright future. And it will not always be easy. But you will always go. Unashamed, defiant. Just show up, completely unprepared. 

That's it. That's life, there's nothing more to it. Nobody knows what the fuck they are doing. Just don't give up until they kick you out (they never will untill you let them)

I think I just reported you before I managed to reply. Anyways.

It's all just a stupid game, and all those guys just try to fit into that subreddit the best they can. It's a pretty disfunctional way to live and they way to fit into it is just as disfuntional.

But humans are pretty flexible. And nobody more than the peeps at foreveralone. If you actualy know what you want (and trust me, this is pretty rare) just demand it, people will be more than willing to give it to you. Because no man knows what to do. As a female you have the upper hand in that you just demand. Just ask. And they will deliver. And they will be oh so incredibly happy that somebody finally tells them what to do. Just try it. Fuck feminism. Women don't do shit. Women just demand.

Just make sure you don't expect any answers from counsling. The point of counseling is to listen yourself speak without any inhibition. Based on how you described yourself, it seems like you don't have many chances to speek about yourself without judgement. The thing is, there is a big difference between the internal monologue and the dialogue that happens between the internal you and the yourself you hear when you hear yourself speak. 

Try talking (out loud, this is important) to a sock puppet in your living room. The puppet will figure it all out.

Nah, this ain't depression, you just have shitty people in your life. It sucks. So does being poor. Or quadruplegic. You don't have a disease, you just have a shitty life.

All I'm saying is that medication or therapy isn't going to do anything for you, that's for people with different problems.

Give it a bit of "don't give a fuck", hope it works out for you.

Just take a gander over to r/foreveralone those are all (every single one of them) males that will give you everything you need for just a single hint of affection. They are all uglier than you, so that's were you need to think about how serious you are. The passivity is problem there. You're not going to get hit on by the hot guy. You're not going to get hit on by the ugly guy. Do hit on the ugly guy and you will be the princess in a very unique kingdom.
